canonical.sourceFilePath: 14. Dynamic Programming/3. 2D DP/04. Minimum Path Sum.cpp

narrative.title: The Toll-Weighted Circuit Board
narrative.scenario: An assembly robot traces a trace from the top-left pad of an m x n circuit board to the bottom-right pad, moving only right or down. Every pad levies a solder-time toll recorded in a grid, and the plant wants each trace to cost as little as possible. Program the planner to report the cheapest achievable toll total across any legal route.
narrative.inputFormat: An m x n matrix grid of non-negative integers, where grid[i][j] is the toll at cell (i, j).
narrative.outputFormat: Return the minimum possible sum of tolls along a right/down path from the top-left to the bottom-right cell.

testCases.explanation: Route 1, 3, 1, 1, 1 hugs the top edge then drops — total 7.

hintLevels: Level 1: Same neighborhood as unique paths, but each cell keeps the cheaper of its two entries.
Level 2: cost[i][j] = grid[i][j] + min(cost[i-1][j], cost[i][j-1]); the corner seeds itself.
Level 3: Reuse a single rolling row; out-of-bounds neighbors are simply ignored rather than set to infinity.
